== Biography ==
The maintained profile estimates Letitia’s birth around 1790 and death in 1871. A Ballymoney death-registration index names Letitia Glasgow aged 81; its birth year is age-derived, and neither birthplace nor natal surname is independently proved by that entry. The selected father [[Glasgow-2539|John Glasgow]] remains 29% uncertain. The earlier opening, ‘Letita was born in 1790. She was the daughter of John Glasgow. She passed away in 1871’, is retained as an inherited claim rather than a certain birth or parentage statement.

[[Glasgow-2539|John Glasgow (bef.1771-)]] is set as the father based on [[Glasgow-2541|Letitia McCormick (Glasgow) Brown (abt.1828-1919)]], daughter of [[Glasgow-2054|Samuel Glasgow (abt.1792-1865)]]
